gaps.sentence: The mixture will ___ as it cools (SOLID).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: solidify means to become solid. A base verb follows 'will'.
The prefix un- forms the negative adjective: unusual. An adjective is needed after 'was'.

gaps.sentence: He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.

gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ (PATIENT) with the children.
gaps.hint: noun needed; beware the similar word meaning 'people in hospital'
gaps.explanation: 'Patience' is the noun (show patience); 'patients' are people receiving medical care.

gaps.sentence: He is under a lot of ___ at work (PRESS).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'a lot of'; fixed phrase 'under ___'
gaps.explanation: 'Under pressure' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'press' is 'pressure'.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ goes back to their schooldays (FRIEND).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the state of being friends (-ship)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ship forms nouns of state: friendship means the relationship between friends.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were unclear, so I had to ___ them completely (WRITE).
gaps.hint: write again — unclear the first time (re-); base verb needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again: rewrite. A base verb is needed after 'had to'.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ about local history (KNOW).
gaps.explanation: 'Knowledgeable about something' means knowing a lot about it; it is the adjective form of 'knowledge'.
